soal: 1. What is the social function of a narrative text?
pilihan: B. To tell stories and entertain readers

soal: 2. Which part of a narrative introduces the characters and setting?
3. Which sentence uses Simple Past Tense, as commonly used in narratives?
pilihan: A. The queen is crying loudly
B. The king will punish her
C. The rooster sang every morning
D. The boy is going home

soal: 4. In the story of Cindelaras, who was jealous of the queen?
5. Why was the queen banished to the woods?
pilihan: B. Because she stole the king’s money
C. Because she was accused of poisoning the concubine
D. Because she wanted to leave the palace

soal: 6. What did the rooster in Cindelaras often sing?
pilihan: A. “The king is wise and kind”
B. “My master is Cindelaras, he’s the son of Raden Putra”

soal: 7. What is the meaning of complication in a narrative?
pilihan: A. The conclusion of the story
B. The rising problem the characters face
D. The moral message of the story

soal: 8. What happened when Bawang Merah opened the big pumpkin?
9. Why did the old woman give Bawang Putih a pumpkin?
pilihan: A. Because Bawang Putih helped her kindly
B. Because she was the old woman’s daughter
C. Because she stole her clothes

soal: 10. Which sentence is Passive Voice?
pilihan: A. The queen punished the concubine
B. The rooster won the game
C. The letter was delivered yesterday
D. The villagers saw the king

soal: 11. Which one is the correct Passive Voice form?
pilihan: A. The story wrote by the author
B. The story was written by the author
C. The story is write by the author
D. The story written by the author

soal: 12. Which verb form is required in Passive Voice?
13. What is the generic structure of narrative?
14. Which sentence shows the resolution of a story?
pilihan: A. The queen was accused of poisoning
C. They finally lived happily together
D. The rooster challenged all other roosters

soal: 15. Which sentence describes an event in Little Red Riding Hood?
pilihan: A. The wolf chased the girl along the path
B. The girl is chasing the wolf
C. The wolf will chase the girl tomorrow
D. The girl chases the wolf every day

soal: 16. What is the main purpose of a report text?
pilihan: B. To describe something in general

soal: 17. Which natural phenomenon appears when sunlight is refracted through water droplets?
18. What colors appear in a rainbow?
pilihan: C. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet

soal: 19. What is a “supermoon”?
pilihan: B. When the moon moves far from Earth
C. When the moon looks larger because it is closer to Earth
D. When the sun is covered by the moon

soal: 20. The text states that an “extreme supermoon” happens when…
pilihan: C. The moon reaches its closest distance to Earth
D. The sun shines very brightly

soal: 21. What is theft according to the report text?
pilihan: B. Taking someone’s property without permission

soal: 22. Which factor may cause theft?
23. What is the main negative impact of theft on society?
pilihan: C. It often involves force and violence
D. It teaches people to be brave

soal: 24. Product advertisements are used to…
25. Which one is a service advertisement?
pilihan: C. Photography studio offering photo services
